reviews.title: Educational
reviews.contents:
Gives good information about development & milestones of babies. I find the videos easy to access and fun to watch. Also gives a lot of tips for fun activities with the baby.👶🏻

Down side is that it gives few reminders before the free subscription expires. And the app charged me the yearly subscription after the free trial which costs more than 100 Canadian dollars 😅

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.contents: I love using this app. It helps with all areas of development. My two year old is a bucket full of energy so I like the variety of activities Kinedu offers.

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.contents: I wish it was much less expensive

reviews.title: A lifesaver app for new parents
reviews.contents: Ideas, classes, guides and trackers all in one place.

reviews.title: Great for new parents !
reviews.contents: I looked at a couple apps when I got my baby and Kinedu was the most complete educational app I found. All the trackers are available but you also have access to a ton of activities to do with your newborn as well as many webinars by different specialist. Love it!

reviews.title: Really nice app
reviews.contents: Really nice app to view ways to achieve milestones ! Its important to pratice a lot but to know every baby achieve their milestones at their own timeline

reviews.title: Love this App!
reviews.contents: It has been extremely helpful in what to expect in each milestone and how to practice certain skills. I love the classes led by professionals and the Q&A part of the classes. Love this App!!

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.contents: You can download free, but you can’t use it free. Also very expensive

reviews.title: unreliable
reviews.contents: was told that i would get an ebook after leaving a review and emailing them after i did it. i did and it’s been over a week and i’ve also followed up and have neither received the ebook nor a reply to my email while still getting other emails. will update my review after this has been addressed
